anchors.dalzell_sarofim_fixture_check: m=1.57-0.56i gives E=0.2595 ~= 0.26: the design's analytic fixture is REPRODUCED by the E(m) formula implementation. The C&C table itself gives E(632.8)=0.228, 12% BELOW the fixture - a dataset difference, not an implementation error.

carrier_note: Draft JSON carrier. Final adoption per FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS8 requires re-encoding as a RISE-CBOR64-v1 byte string; the adopted record ID is SHA-256 of those exact CBOR bytes. The draft_record_id here covers only this JSON payload.
conflicts_flagged: MAGNITUDE: modern consensus E(m) in the visible is 0.32-0.40 (Liu et al. 2020, Aerosol Sci. Tech. 54:33-51: measured E(m) 0.35-0.4; lower limit 0.32 from MAC=8.0 m2/g @550). C&C's ~0.23 implies hot-soot MAC(633)=3.77 m2/g vs directly measured in-flame 7.1+/-1.1 (Forestieri 2018, implied E~0.43). Adopting C&C as-is underpredicts visible soot absorption/emission by ~40%. Precedented alternative: keep C&C spectral shape, rescale offsets to a modern magnitude (Flanner et al. 2012 did exactly this to hit 1.95-0.79i @550). OWNER DECISION.
The design's Phase-A fixture E=0.26 (Dalzell-Sarofim) sits between C&C (0.23) and modern consensus (0.32-0.40).

dispersion_formulas.coefficient_provenance: Chang & Charalampopoulos 1990, Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 430:577-591, DOI 10.1098/rspa.1990.0107. PRIMARY PAYWALLED: coefficients verified verbatim against three independent secondary sources: Wen et al. Sensors 22:8199 (2022) Eqs.(5)-(6) p.5; Yelverton NCSU PhD thesis Eq.(1.1) pp.19-20; Flanner et al. ACP 12:4699 (2012) Eqs.(13)-(14) p.4706 (non-constant coefficients). Equation/table numbers within the primary are unverified.

experimental_basis.caveats: Spherical-particle assumption; C&C themselves label the result an 'effective' refractive index (Moteki 2023 p.3). Known fit-vs-tabulated discrepancy: widely quoted C&C point value 1.77-0.63i @540nm does not equal the fit's 1.73-0.59i @540nm; unresolved without primary.
experimental_basis.flame: premixed propane-oxygen flat flame, equivalence ratio 1.8 (Bond & Bergstrom 2006 Table 4; ADS abstract)
experimental_basis.technique: in-situ spectral extinction 0.2-6.4 um + dynamic light scattering at 0.488 um, inverted via Kramers-Kronig (Zhu 2002; Moteki 2023)

fit_validity_provenance: SECONDARY ONLY (Thermopedia soot article et al.); the >6.4 um portion is a Kramers-Kronig extrapolation. Primary verification required before SS3.5 integrates it as the long-wave extension SS12 Q2 demands. 0.2-0.4 um is excluded from fit validity.
measured_range_provenance: Verified via Zhu et al. Proc. Combust. Inst. 29:2367 (2002) p.2373 (NIST open copy) and Moteki et al. 2023 EarthArXiv preprint p.3, plus the ADS abstract.
